item.title: USWNT’s World Cup winner Crystal Dunn, 33, announces retirement from professional soccer
item.description: Crystal Dunn, one of the most accomplished players in the history of the U.S. women’s national team, announced Thursday that she is retiring from professional soccer at age 33, bringing an end to a remarkable 12-year career.
